title: Variables
explain: Variables are containers that store values like numbers, text, or true/false. You create a variable using `let`, `const`, or `var`, give it a name, and assign a value with the equals sign. Once created, you can use the variable's name anywhere in your code to access or change its value.
exercise: Create a variable for your favorite color, another for your birth year, and a third that calculates how many years ago you were born (using the current year 2024). Print all three variables.
tip: Use `const` by default because it prevents accidental changes. Use `let` only when you need to reassign the variable. Avoid `var` in modern JavaScript—it has confusing scoping rules.
